title: Sturdy Coffee Table
text: Sturdy Coffee Table. This is a sturdy coffee table. It looks nice in my daughter's new apartment. It was easy to put together. The size is good. For the price, it's definitely a bargain!

product_metadata.title: LINSY HOME Industrial Coffee Table for Living Room, Wood Coffee Table Rectangle with Sturdy Metal Frame and Wood Finish, Fits for Simple Rustic & Modern Style, Easy Assembly
features: Simply Designed Coffee Table with Striking Industrial Look - This rectangular coffee table offers a classic look and pairs well with most standard sofas. The rich wood color and dark steel frame complement each other well, the steel frame with rustic distressed-effect hardwood top creates a stylish centerpiece for your living room.

Considerately Crafted with Rounded Corner - Coffee table designed with four rounded corners to improve safety for your kid or child when they are running or playing, you do not have to worry about injury.

Solid, Stable & Long-lasting Construction - Durable composite board tabletop and sturdy iron pipe frame lend exceptional strength and ensure the table's structural integrity over time. The high-quality hardwood delivers an even finish and it can be easily wiped clean.

Perfect Size Fits Most of Furniture and Space - It's a practical coffee table yet has a stylish retro feel. The size of table top is 41.3"X19.7" and the table top is 16.8" off the ground. The table weights 21.1 pounds. The top board can support 150 pounds.

Easily Assembled & Hassle-free Purchase - Simply attach the legs to start enjoying your coffee table. LINSY HOME coffee table comes with step-by-step instructions and tools, you can easily put them together on your own effortlessly within 20 minutes. LINSY HOME provides satisfactory customer service and 1-year warranty.
